title: Office Tech & IT Issues
completion_message: ¡Genial! Ahora sabes cómo reportar problemas técnicos comunes en la oficina.

stages.title: Problemas de Tecnología y TI (IT Issues)

parts.visual: The screen froze (La pantalla se congeló). The system crashed (El sistema se cayó). My laptop died (Mi laptop se apagó/quedó sin batería). I can't log in (No puedo iniciar sesión).
parts.audio: The screen froze. The system crashed. My laptop died. I can't log in.

parts.visual: Soluciones: Reboot/Restart the computer (Reinicia la computadora). Unplug and plug it back in (Desconecta y vuelve a conectar). Clear the cache (Borra la caché). Call IT support (Llama a soporte técnico).
parts.audio: Solutions: Reboot or restart the computer. Unplug and plug it back in. Clear the cache. Call IT support.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta para describir el problema tecnológico.

questions.question: My screen ____. I can't move the mouse. (Se congeló).
The entire system ____. We lost all our data. (Se cayó/colapsó).
My phone battery ____. I need a charger. (Murió/Se agotó).
questions.explanation: Cuando la batería se agota, decimos 'it died'.

questions.question: I can't ____ in to my email. It says 'wrong password'. (Iniciar sesión).
Have you tried to ____ the computer? (Reiniciar).
Please ____ the cable and plug it back in. (Desconectar).
You should clear the browser's ____. (Caché).
questions.explanation: Clear the cache = limpiar/borrar la caché.

questions.question: My keyboard is not ____. (No está funcionando).
I will call ____ support. (Soporte técnico / TI).
The printer is out of ____. (No tiene papel).
The printer is out of ____. (No tiene tinta).
The Wi-Fi connection is very ____ today. (Lenta).
I forgot my ____. I can't access my account. (Contraseña).
Could you ____ my password, please? (Restablecer).
questions.explanation: Reset a password = restablecer una contraseña.

questions.question: I accidentally ____ the file! Can we recover it? (Eliminé).
Please ____ the document on your desktop. (Guardar).
Did you ____ a backup? (Hiciste una copia de seguridad).
questions.explanation: Make a backup = hacer una copia de seguridad.

questions.question: The email has a large ____. (Archivo adjunto).
The server is ____ right now. (Caído / Fuera de servicio).
questions.explanation: The server is down = el servidor está caído.

questions.question: My mouse is completely ____. It doesn't move. (Muerto/No funciona).
questions.explanation: Dead = no tiene energía o no funciona en absoluto.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo o palabra clave de tecnología.

questions.question: Did you make a ____? (Copia de seguridad)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Have you tried to reboot the computer?
options: Have you tried to reboot the computer?
Have you tried to restart the computer?
Did you try to reboot the computer?
Have you tried to reboot the system?
questions.correct_answer: Have you tried to reboot the computer?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The server is down right now.
options: The server is down right now.
The system is down right now.
The internet is down right now.
questions.correct_answer: The server is down right now.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Could you reset my password, please?
options: Could you reset my password, please?
Can you reset my password, please?
Could you restart my password, please?
questions.correct_answer: Could you reset my password, please?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The printer is out of paper.
options: The printer is out of paper.
The printer is out of ink.
My printer is out of paper.
The machine is out of paper.
questions.correct_answer: The printer is out of paper.
